subject.title: Bug: Isolated cron job delivery.mode=announce fails with 'Channel openclaw-weixin does not support action send'

question: Should this issue wait for a live current-main Weixin cron repro, or should maintainers treat the stable 2026.6.10 repro plus source evidence as enough to sponsor a targeted fix?
rationale: Source inspection shows both the reported gateway action failure and a current direct outbound fallback, so the unresolved question is proof sufficiency for the remaining runtime path rather than product direction.

options.title: Require live current-main proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or reporter verifies the same Weixin cron job on current main or v2026.6.11+ and captures the route that still reaches `message.action`.

options.title: Sponsor a targeted regression now
options.body: Accept the stable repro as sufficient and add a focused Weixin-shaped channel fixture proving cron fallback uses outbound send after message-tool action failure.

options.title: Close after release verification
options.body: Close only if someone verifies that v2026.6.11+ delivers the same isolated cron announce job through Weixin successfully.

recommendation.title: Require live current-main proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or reporter verifies the same Weixin cron job on current main or v2026.6.11+ and captures the route that still reaches `message.action`.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged text-only cron announce delivery work is the closest existing implementation of the intended generic fix.
